text: {"lessons":["I should base trades on expected risk and return, not on reluctance to admit a purchase was a mistake; average cost is not a reason by itself to hold or sell.","A few months of gains or losses do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term price moves and trade only when my plan or portfolio needs it.","I should keep diversification and position sizes in view: selling some B and C while adding A, D, and E changed my exposures, so I should review the whole portfolio before trading."]}
